biological_replicate: Dyrk1b HepKO mice and Flox controls
Primary hepatocytes extracted from Dyrk1b HepKO mice and Flox controls were transfected with Ad-encoding Flag-FoxO1, and affinity purified.
experimental_design: comparison of FOXO1 phosphorylation between Dyrk1b HepKO and Flox control hepatocytes

Analysis by mass spectrometry identified six phosphorylation sites that were abolished on FOXO1 (S22, S279, S303, T425, T467, and S468, rows 7 to 12 in Flox column) in Dyrk1b-deficient cells but present in Flag-FOXO1 in control hepatocytes
factor_value: Primary hepatocytes extracted from Dyrk1b HepKO mice and Flox controls
